title: Personal Training Packages: the established-membership requirement for backdating an archived package's closed date
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Personal Training Packages product line and states the club-membership basis for whether an archived package's closed date may be backdated.

## Rule
The closed-date backdating courtesy is extended only to an established membership: the member's own club membership must be active and must have been continuously open for at least 30 calendar days by the current moment. Where the membership is not active, or is active but has not yet been continuously open for 30 calendar days, the membership is not established for this purpose.

## Points of judgement
- If the member's club membership is active and has been continuously open for at least 30 calendar days by the current moment, the membership is established for this purpose.
- If the member's club membership is not active, it is not established for this purpose regardless of how long ago it was opened.
- If the member's club membership is active but has been open for fewer than 30 calendar days, it is not yet established for this purpose.
The membership's own opened date is the record this 30-day tenure is measured against; a membership opened exactly 30 calendar days before the current moment already satisfies this requirement, since the requirement is a minimum rather than a strict excess.
